minecolonies:gunner.job.desc: Equipped with firearms from Iron's Artifice. Delivers devastating ranged volleys and kites enemies.
minecolonies:mage.job.desc: Harnesses arcane arts from Iron's Spells. Casts offensive and supportive spells to protect the colony.
Introduce gunpowder weaponry to the colony defense.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Unlocks Gunner Guard in Guard Towers and permits Tier 1 firearms (Flintlock Pistol, Blackpowder Revolver, Six Shooter).
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Equip colony gunners with military longarms.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Permits Tier 2 firearms: Muskets and Blunderbusses.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Harness high-precision mechanisms and devastating munitions.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Permits Tier 3 firearms: Arquebuses and Clockwork Rifles.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Dampen firearm recoil for higher fire rate and stopping power.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Reduces delay between shots by -25% and enhances bullet impact knockback on targets.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Advanced cylinder and magazine loading mechanisms for rapid continuous fire.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Extends volley capacity to 6 continuous rounds and cuts reload time in half. Completely safe for colony structures.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Train marksmen in steady aiming and volley discipline.
Advanced drills in recoil control and rapid target acquisition.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Increases Gunner firearm damage by an additional +10% (+20% total).
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Master marksmen capable of lethal precision under fire.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Increases Gunner firearm damage by an additional +10% (+30% total).
com.minecolonies.research.combat.gunner_: Supreme gunners capable of lightning-fast reloading and lethal accuracy.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.gunner: Increases Gunner firearm damage by +10% (+40% total) and reduces volley reload delay by -20%.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage.su: Train colony guards in the arts of spellcasting.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage.d: Unlocks Mage Guard in Guard Towers and permits Tier 1 spell tools (Flimsy Journal, Graybeard Staff).
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_ar: Supply sturdier tomes and finely balanced casting implements.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage_a: Permits Tier 2 spell tools: Apprentice's Spell Book, Ironbound Tome, Artificer's Cane, and Amethyst Rapier.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_ar: Channel the primal energies of fire, ice, and lightning.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage_a: Permits Tier 3 spell tools: Enchanted Spell Book, Blaze Manual, Frostbranded Book, Ice Staff, Rod o' Lightning, and Pyrium Staff.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_ar: Unlock ancient scrolls, evocation grimoires, and spatial mastery.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage_a: Permits Tier 4 spell tools: Grimoire of Evokation, Villager Bible, Dragonskin Book, Vampiric Book, Hither Wand, and Spellbreaker.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_ar: Harness forbidden netherite relics and forgotten eldritch power.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage_a: Permits Tier 5 spell tools: Ancient Codex, Necronomicon, The Blood Staff, and Decrepit Flamberge.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_fo: Meditation techniques to concentrate internal magical reserves.
Harmonize mana channels for deeper arcane resonance.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage_d: Increases Mage spell damage by an additional +10% (+20% total).
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_fo: Pure mana convergence that surges through every incantation.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.mage_d: Increases Mage spell damage by an additional +10% (+30% total).
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mage_fo: Transcend mortal limits of spellcasting with near-instant incantations.
